purpose: 核心复现，能区分修复前后。像公开测试一样 mock 掉代理连接（loop.create_connection 返回已完成的 Future），分别经公开方法 connect() 和题面使用的 _create_connection() 各走一遍。先打印三条参考 info 行（无端口、显式 :80、带 userinfo 和查询串；:80 那条随实现不同，只看不判），再断言无端口 URL 仍为 http://www.python.org/、题面 URL 为 http://localhost:1234/path。base 上预计两条 issue case 都是 'http://localhost/path'，以 AssertionError 退出码 1 结束；修复后应打印 OK 并以 0 退出。
cmd:
python -B -c '
import asyncio
from unittest import mock
import aiohttp
from aiohttp.client import ClientRequest
loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
loop_mock = mock.Mock()
done = asyncio.Future(loop=loop)
done.set_result((mock.Mock(), mock.Mock()))
loop_mock.create_connection.return_value = done
connector = aiohttp.ProxyConnector("http://proxy.example.com", loop=loop_mock)
def via(url, public=True):
    req = ClientRequest("GET", url)
    coro = connector.connect(req) if public else connector._create_connection(req)
    loop.run_until_complete(coro)
    return req.path
for url in ("http://www.python.org", "http://localhost:80/path", "http://user:pass@localhost:1234/path?a=1"):
    print("info:", url, "->", repr(via(url)))
got_connect = via("http://localhost:1234/path")
got_create = via("http://localhost:1234/path", public=False)
print("issue case via connect():", repr(got_connect))
print("issue case via _create_connection():", repr(got_create))
assert via("http://www.python.org") == "http://www.python.org/", "no-port URL changed"
assert got_connect == "http://localhost:1234/path", got_connect
assert got_create == "http://localhost:1234/path", got_create
print("OK: port kept in proxied request path")
'
